title: Final Pressure Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the pressure p in terms of the photon gas parameters and derivatives.

title: Frequency Derivative
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the relationship for the partial derivative of frequency with respect to volume.

title: Pressure-Energy Relation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must show the relationship between pressure p and energy density U.

title: Temperature Comparison
description: Important Criteria: The student must set up the comparison between thermal radiation pressure and kinetic pressure of hydrogen gas.

title: Correct Temperature Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for temperature at which the pressures are equal.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes in derivatives or incorrect assumptions about constants.
